observations: Photo 0 shows a single-slab PlayStation console (not the triple-tier PS4 Pro shape) with a white Galactic Empire sunburst decal and 'STAR WARS' text printed on the front edge — this is the known Star Wars Battlefront special-edition PS4 (standard/'Fat') console design.
Two DualShock 4 wireless controllers sit on top of the console.
A power brick/cable and an HDMI cable are coiled on top of the unit.
No rear panel, serial plate, model number sticker, or power-on screen is visible.
Background shows a wall socket and a blue door/frame, consistent with a home photo, not a studio or storefront shot.
No photo shows the console running, a game loading, or a controller paired and lit up.

identity.kind: PS4 console, Star Wars Battlefront special edition, with two controllers and cables
read_from: photo 0 console shell design and 'STAR WARS' branding

claims.evidence: Photo 0: the console body is a single flat slab matching the original PS4 'Fat' Star Wars Battlefront special edition shape, not the taller, triple-layer PS4 Pro chassis.
No power-on, boot screen, or gameplay clip is shown in the single photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (common with used consoles, e.g. disc drive or HDD failure)
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and loading a game
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst case

risks.risk: Seller's claimed model (PS4 Pro) does not match the console's visible shape, raising doubt about true specs (storage size, CPU/GPU revision)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear panel and the model/serial sticker on the underside of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value standard PS4 Fat, not as a Pro

risks.risk: Controllers' battery health, stick drift, or charging port condition unknown
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connected and responsive in a game menu

risks.risk: No games or storage capacity confirmed despite marketing tone
risks.proof: A photo of the system storage/settings screen showing installed games and free space
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare console with no bundled games

proof_requests: Photo of the rear panel showing ports and the model/serial sticker
Video of the console powering on and loading a game
Photo of both controllers connected and working in the PS4 menu
Photo of the system settings screen showing storage capacity
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Star Wars special-edition PS4 'Fat' console with two controllers, but the seller's 'PS4 Pro' claim is contradicted by the console's visible shape, and no functional proof is shown, so it is priced at the worst case as a standard used PS4 Fat bundle with two pads.
